test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1): Morning Practice - Day 1
subject: general
question: Six friends G, H, I, J, K, and L are watching a cricket match sitting in a row facing North. G and I are at the extreme ends. K is the neighbour of L and J. H is to the immediate right of G and L is third to the left of I. Who is sitting second to the left of K in the row?
solution:
The seating arrangement is as follows:

G and I are at the extreme ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/481638c3d907b443d2441b36ec9644b5938a3db6adf111675fa638211d3fae71.png] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6405b559b4201ca00f26d521675d2421e79948a323bd941e7c998cc80a6f83f9.png] 

H is to the immediate right of G and L is third to the left of I. As there is no place for H to the right of G, Case 1 gets eliminated.

K is the neighbour of L and J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38316caabc1021f997214d145cfcf3b57453f6e8b7556fff7c18009c22f4f052.png] 

Hence, H is sitting second to the left of K.
